Share screen shows 'SEND THE SURPRISE' header; Tomorrow + 6:00 PM → invitation-when '📅 Tue, Sep 8, 6:00 PM'; share-add-calendar-button visible and tappable (web toast); Copy Invitation → 'Invitation copied ✨' toast. Non-owner (fresh localStorage) opening /spark/{id} directly sees invite-banner + surprise-card ('A mystery plan, just for you') + no itinerary + footer 'I'm in! 🎉' (invite-footer-button); tapping invite-accept-button toasts "You're in! Saved to My Sparks 🎉" and opens auth Sign Up screen. Non-premium guest on Create tapping occasion-birthday routes to /premium (premium-screen visible with reason=occasion); Maybe Later returns to Create. No React Native red screens observed. Deprecated packages detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: budget-option-* Pressables do NOT respond to real mouse click on RN-Web — the OnPress handler never fires with page.click() or a synthetic mouse click at the row's bbox center; only a manually dispatched PointerEvent (pointerdown+pointerup) triggers selection. Other Pressables in the wizard (who-option-*, vibe-option-*, distance-option-*, occasion-*) work with normal clicks, so this is specific to budget.tsx. Users on web/desktop can still touch-tap on a touchscreen but a mouse click leaves Continue disabled forever. Likely related to the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning triggered on that screen — pointer-events may be blocked by the Animated.View parent's style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/create/budget.tsx:40-53

issues: Banner reads 'Someone wants to spend time with you ✨' — the spec asked for a 'YOU'RE INVITED' banner. Wording is friendlier but does not include the literal 'YOU'RE INVITED' string. Non-blocking, just callout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' In react-native-web this can cause the parent to swallow pointer events on descendants — see the budget UI bug above. Reference: /app/frontend/app/create/budget.tsx and any component still passing pointerEvents as a prop.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not blocking. Same as iteration 1.

action_items: Investigate why <Pressable> inside <Animated.View> on /create/budget swallows real mouse clicks in RN-Web. Likely fix: remove any `pointerEvents` prop from the Animated.View parent (or move it into style.pointerEvents) so the child Pressable receives clicks. Verify Continue enables after a normal click. Same guidance applies to any other screen still using `props.pointerEvents`.
(Optional) Align invite banner copy with spec — if 'YOU'RE INVITED' is the intended header, add it as a small caps label above the current friendly line.
(Optional) Migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.

rca_of_issue: Budget step click regression: the Pressable in /app/frontend/app/create/budget.tsx sits inside an Animated.View from react-native-reanimated. RN-Web currently prints 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — the deprecated pointerEvents prop on that parent (or on a StickyFooter/ScrollView ancestor) can cause react-native-web to render pointer-events:none on the wrapper, so mouse/touch events never reach the inner Pressable. Reproduce: on desktop web, click any $ row on /create/budget — nothing happens, Continue stays disabled. Mitigation: replace `pointerEvents` prop usage with style.pointerEvents (or remove entirely) on the ancestors of that Pressable, or wrap it in a plain <View style={{ pointerEvents: 'auto' }}> as an escape hatch.
